listing.description: Classic mid-century modern architecture meets thoughtful, substantial improvements in this beautifully maintained home, cherished by the same owner for over 40 years. Soaring wood ceilings, exposed beams, expansive windows, and a striking stone fireplace define the inviting living room, filling the space with warmth, character, and natural light.  The well-designed floor plan flows easily from the living room into the bright, spacious kitchen and dining area, with direct access to a private, beautifully landscaped yard and patio. This natural connection between indoor and outdoor spaces makes the home equally suited to everyday living and entertaining.  Each bedroom enjoys a lovely outlook onto mature trees and greenery, creating a peaceful sense of retreat. Dual-pane windows throughout frame the surrounding landscape while complementing the home’s distinctive architecture.  Significant foundation and seismic improvements completed in 2019, along with a newer furnace, air-conditioning system, and ducting, reflect the owner’s investment in the home’s structure and systems. An attached two-car garage with a Tesla charger adds convenience and storage.  A special opportunity to own a distinctive mid-century modern home with enduring architectural appeal, inviting outdoor spaces, and a legacy of thoughtful care.

verdict: A meticulously kept 1962 mid-century modern in a wooded Montclair canyon that trades away any bay view and usable yard for privacy, character, and calm. The structure and systems are the rare dialed-in kind — 2019 foundation/seismic work, newer furnace/AC/ducting, dual-pane windows — and the single-level layout with a glass gable wall and terraced patio is genuinely charming. At $520/sf it is priced to move for the hills, but it sits in presumptive Very High FHSZ territory with trees overhanging the roof, so the insurance quote, not the house, decides whether this deal works.
